annotations.title: Switch a Google Ads automated rule on or off

description: ENABLED means Hermoso runs it on its schedule with nobody watching. A rule that can only pause, lower or notify needs confirm:true; one that can enable or RAISE needs confirm:true AND confirmScope (from list_google_ads_rules). Calling without them changes nothing and says what it would do. DISABLED stops it at once and is never gated (it does not put back what it changed: undo_google_ads_rule_action does). Free.

confirm.description: true once the user has said yes to exactly what the refusal described

confirmScope.description: the scopeToken the list tool (or the refusal) prints; required with confirm when the rule can raise spend

name: set_google_ads_rule_status
title: Switch a Google Ads automated rule on or off
